targets.acquisition_status_note: Corrected 2026-08-26: the previous value BLOCKED_NO_CDS_CREDENTIALS was stale and false. CDS credentials work - they acquired and converted the Lyon fold - and the ES/GB/IT sequential ERA5 download is live. Status returns to a terminal value only when EU-07/T06 converts this fold and runs the six DR08 gates.

diary_fieldwork.survey: INE Encuesta de Empleo del Tiempo 2009-2010
diary_fieldwork.source: INE operation methodology page for the 2009-2010 time-use survey

targets.diary_window_note: Ruled D-EU-16 on 2026-08-26, option (a): the diary year is the calendar year holding the majority of the survey's fieldwork. All three surveys put the majority in the SECOND calendar year, so the intuitive first-year default would have been wrong for every fold (FINDING EU-S2-03). Pinning the diary window does not by itself pin the fold: `status` becomes RULED_PINNED only when the six DR08 gates pass on the converted EPW.
